commits_this_run: 82d8a64 fix(ops): report the exact oldest retained access entry (NEX-087)
decisions_this_run: A new port method, not a bigger page. Raising the 1000-entry cap would move the cliff rather than remove it and would leave the field's truthfulness a function of traffic; 'what is the oldest row' has an exact answer (MIN), so the question is asked directly.

Delete _OLDEST_SCAN_LIMIT rather than keep it as a safety valve. A constant whose own comment admits it 'never claims to be exhaustive' is the defect written down, and keeping it would invite a future reader to reuse the bounded read.
None still means 'empty log'. Engineering a sentinel timestamp for 'nothing retained' would make an empty log look like a very old log - the same class of lie in a different place.
The SQL MIN result is relabelled to aware UTC with the same rule UTCDateTime applies, because SQLite returns a naive datetime for a plain TIMESTAMP column and the domain speaks aware UTC.
run_summary: Run 87 found and fixed a truthfulness defect in the operator-access retention report. retained_from was derived from the last element of a capped newest-first page, so past 1000 survivors it understated how far back the retained evidence reached - the reassuring direction, worse as traffic grew, and invisible to a suite whose every fixture was under one page. A probe reproduced it (1500 survivors: reported 12:08:22 vs a true oldest of 12:00:00). The port gained an exact oldest_retained() (MIN(at) in SQL, insertion order in the ring, min() in the spy); the use case delegates and _OLDEST_SCAN_LIMIT is gone. Six new tests, each chosen so a page-derived implementation cannot satisfy it; mutation control proved the key regression fails without the fix. Full suite exit 0, ruff/mypy clean. Product commit 82d8a64 pushed to feature/agentic-enterprise-platform (remote head verified). NEX-087 remains NOT VERIFIED because no CI verdict has been read, and it is not yet delivered to PR #5 or issue #2 - both are the next run's work.
